text:
alice: Hey team — trying the mac quickstart sample app and my first API call returns 403. I set REDWOOD_API_KEY in my shell and restarted terminal. curl response: {
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "reason": "billing_required"
}

bob: @alice that usually means the workspace doesn't have a payment method attached or the org invite wasn't fully accepted. can you paste the exact curl you ran?

alice: sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```
response code 403 and body from API: {"msg":"billing_required", "help_url":"https://console.redwood.com/billing"}

carol: quick question — did you accept the workspace invite with the same email as your console account? we've seen tokens come from the wrong workspace if you have multiple accounts. also check ~/.redwoodrc for leftover tokens.

alice: accepted invite with work email, checked ~/.redwoodrc — it had an old token from a sandbox. removed it and retried but still 403.

dave: there's an SDK parity quirk we recently discovered: node SDK will auto-retry an initial 401/429 but python SDK only retries idempotent endpoints. this is logged in GH issue #2345. could be masking a transient auth mismatch.

alice: interesting — i tried both node quickstart and python sample. node printed a retry attempt but still returned billing error. python failed fast.

bob: if the API returns billing_required, retries won't help until a payment method is added. the retry behavior is separate.

emily (support): @alice I'm pulling your workspace. I see an org flag: "billing_gated". owner needs to attach a card or enable invoice billing. i can DM steps and a one-click invite to the owner.

alice: omg that explains it. is there a clearer error the SDK could show? 403 + a terse body is confusing for new devs.

carol: agreed — UX suggestion: include a top-level code like `billing_required` and `help_url` in errors. devrel-bot: noted and adding to backlog. :memo:

devrel-bot: new issue created: DX-512 - improve quickstart error for billing gating (link: https://go/repo/issue/DX-512)

bob: interim workaround: use a personal org that has a payment method, or have the org owner add a card via console -> Billing -> Payment methods. also check token precedence: SDK order is ENV -> ~/.redwoodrc -> metadata server. if an old token exists it can confuse things.

alice: FYI for mac/docker users — when running Docker quickstart use `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY ...` or bind `~/.redwoodrc` into the container. otherwise container won't see your key.

emily (support): i escalated to billing ops with the workspace id and owner contact. i'll post when it's unblocked.

alice: added card with owner, retried — first call now returns 200. :tada: output looks good. thanks everyone for the triage and the tips on token precedence + docker env.

dave: follow-up task: unify retry behavior across SDKs for auth+transient errors and improve log text for billing_required. i'll link GH PRs.

carol: also adding a short note to the quickstart README about the `billing_required` case and token precedence. small docs change should save time for new devs. :+1:

alice: closing loop — unblocked and demo-ready. thanks! :rocket:
